import pathlib,hashlib,json,importlib.util,copy
P=pathlib.Path('/Users/sb/code/opensip-ai/opensip/docs/coop/completion');s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('compound_review',P/'check_manifest_completed_v1.py');m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(m)
v=json.loads((P/'manifest-compound-report.v1.json').read_text());a,b=[r['input'] for r in v['results']];t=copy.deepcopy(b);leaf=t['commands'].pop();assert t==a and leaf['parent']=='child';rows=[]
def run(name,value,want,datum=None):
 raw=json.dumps(value,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=True).encode()
 try:out=m.validate(raw,{},json.loads((P/'manifest-bases.completed.v1.json').read_text()),json.loads((P/'manifest-artifact-blobs.completed.v1.json').read_text()))
 except m.Refuse as e:out={'verdict':e.code,'datum':e.datum}
 rows.append({'id':name,'input':value,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'actual':out,'expected':want,'passed':out['verdict']==want})
run('retained-positive',a,'ACCEPT');run('retained-negative',b,'RJ-2')
x=copy.deepcopy(b);x['commands'][-1]['parent']='left';run('unambiguous-existing-parent',x,'ACCEPT')
x=copy.deepcopy(b);x['commands'][-1]['parent']='missing';run('unknown-parent',x,'RJ-2')
x=copy.deepcopy(a);x['commands'][-1]['parent']='left';run('duplicate-child-same-parent',x,'RJ-2')
for row,source in zip(rows[:2],v['results']):assert row['sha256']==source['inputSha256']
r={'total':len(rows),'passed':sum(x['passed'] for x in rows),'pairedOnlyDifference':leaf,'probes':rows};assert r['passed']==r['total'];pathlib.Path('/tmp/manifest-compound-probes.v1.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n');print(r['passed'],r['total']);print(rows[1]['actual'])
